name: Acererak Construct
tactics: The Acererak construct flies high enough to avoid melee attacks as it uses drain soul. It falls back on shadow ray flurry only until drain soul recharges and as long as no creatures are in its guarded area. When a target’s soul is trapped in one of the construct’s soul gems, it uses consume soul as soon as possible. The construct’s guarded area is within 1 square of the suspended shadow engine, and on the floor within 2 squares of the teleportation circle. If any character is within the guarded area (including characters on or flying adjacent to the eldritch engine), the construct uses drain soul against him or her.

alignment.name: Evil
alignment.description:
Evil creatures don’t necessarily go out of their way to hurt people, but they’re perfectly willing to take advantage of the weakness of others to acquire what they want.
	Evil creatures use rules and order to maximize personal gain. They don’t care whether laws hurt other people. They support institutional structures that give them power, even if that power comes at the expense of others’ freedom. Slavery and rigid caste structures are not only acceptable but desirable to evil creatures, as long as they are in a position to benefit from them.

description: Four individual Tiny creatures can fit in a square, and a Tiny creature can enter a larger creature’s space and end its turn there. Having a reach of 0 means a Tiny creature cannot make melee attacks against targets outside its own space, unless otherwise noted.

traits.name: Intruding Terror
traits.details: Enemies within the aura take a -2 penalty to attack rolls.

traits.name: Guard Area
traits.details: The construct uses drain soul against any creature in its guarded area, even if the power hasn’t recharged.

traits.name: Soul Gems
traits.details: The construct has four soul gems that can each hold the soul of one of the construct’s victims. At the start of the encounter, one of the soul gems contains a soul. Crushing a gem after the construct is defeated releases that soul to the Shadowfell.

auras.name: Intruding Terror
auras.details: Enemies within the aura take a -2 penalty to attack rolls.

effect.description: The construct uses shadow ray four times, each against a different target.

hit.description: The target is dazed and restrained (save ends both).

failedSavingThrows.name: AverageDamage
failedSavingThrows.description: The target is instead stunned (save ends).

failedSavingThrows.name: AverageDamage
failedSavingThrows.description: The target dies, and its soul is trapped in one of the construct’s soul gems until the construct is destroyed; see “Fate of Drained Souls."

effect.description: The construct expends a trapped soul from one of its soul gems and regains 157 hit points.

powers.name: Soul Shriveling Pulse
powers.trigger: A creature fails a saving throw against drain soul.

hit.description: necrotic damage, and the target takes a -2 penalty to saving throws (save ends).
